# network address frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:networkAddressFrame`](gmeow-networkAddressFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/networkAddressFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The network reference frame in which this address is expressed. Functional: an address is expressed in exactly one frame.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:networkAddressFrame`](gmeow-networkAddressFrame.md) from [`gmeow:NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) to [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md), [`gmeow:NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md), [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the single network reference frame in which an address is expressed; functional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid leaving it absent on a promoted [`NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) (the frame gate warns) and avoid giving two frames.

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:networkAddressFrame`](gmeow-networkAddressFrame.md) nested under [`gmeow:referenceFrameInternet`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameInternet.md) via [`gmeow:parentFrame`](gmeow-parentFrame.md).

### Examples

- ex:siteAddr [`gmeow:networkAddressFrame`](gmeow-networkAddressFrame.md) [`gmeow:referenceFrameIPv4`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameIPv4.md).
